annotations.title: Get daily price history of a tracked product

description: Returns one entry per day for a tracked product over the requested window (1 to 90 days, 30 by default): rank, gap to the best price, offer count and the offers that changed that day. Days beyond the plan retention come back locked. Optional `channelId` restricts to one marketplace.
name: get_product_price_history
title: Get daily price history of a tracked product
